messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency spike detected on production-serving pool 'eu-west-2' for model variant 'llama-lite-v2-alpha'. 5xx rate increased to 4.8% over 5m, p95 token latency 2.3s (+120%).

mira-oncall: ack I'm paged, looking...

mira-oncall: digging into metrics — errors correlate with heavy keys: key=acme-ads-prod, key=beta-user-traffic.

dmitri: logs show KVcache OOM on quantized path for llama-lite-v2-alpha; repro on 32-token long inputs.

ashley: rolling back? we have stable 'llama-lite-v1' with quantized safety profile.

mira-oncall: plan: 1) throttle heavy keys 2) shift traffic off v2-alpha to v1 3) apply temporary quota for new keys

sam-sre: I'm going to update routing policy: set variant weight v2-alpha=0 and v1=100 for region eu-west-2. Command:

```
redwood route set-weights --model llama-lite --variant v2-alpha=0,v1=100 --region eu-west-2 --reason "evacuate risky variant"
```

deploy-bot: Received routing change request by sam-sre. Applying...

deploy-bot: Routing update applied successfully. RequestID: r78910

katrina-eng: applying ephemeral emergency quotas: blockburst throttle to 10rps per key for 30m.

```
redwood quota update --scope key:acme-ads-prod --burst 10 --sustained 2 --ttl 30m
```

mira-oncall: also disabling model debug feature toggles for v2-alpha to remove heavier ops: `feature-toggle disable llama-lite-v2-alpha-debug`.

dmitri: confirming error rate dropping in metric dashboard, p95 down to 0.8s, 5xx to 0.6%.

customer-success: CS note: impacted customers from billing logs: acme-ads-prod and beta-sms; reach out queued.

mira-oncall: good. We'll keep v2-alpha offline and monitor for 1h. Handoff to night oncall in 45m.

ashley: creating incident issue and timeline in Jira PRJ-3421. Added root cause hypothesis and mitigation steps.

mira-oncall: handoff @lee-nightoncall in 45m. Lee, you'll have runbook: check /incidents/llama-lite-v2-alpha, verify metric p95<1s before restoring any traffic.

lee-nightoncall: ack, will take at 04:15Z. Contact number +1-555-0102.

incident-bot: incident severity set to Sev2 — customer impact limited to a few high-volume keys. Links: https://console.redwood/incident/2048123456

mira-oncall: closing this thread for now, continue in postmortem channel. :white_check_mark:
